title: Lead Treasury Analyst
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Treasury Analyst will join the Portfolio Strategy and Analytics team and support forecasts for the Wells Fargo Investment Portfolio across capital, interest rate risk, balance sheet, income, and liquidity under multiple scenarios. The role requires expertise in fixed-income modeling, Asset Liability Management, Interest Rate Risk, stress-testing, and model governance, along with strong partnership and matrix-management skills.

**In this role, you will:**

  

* Execute investment portfolio forecasting and analytics, including interest rate risk, valuation, balance sheet, income, capital, and liquidity analysis.
* Analyze month-over-month portfolio and forecast movements, identify material drivers, and translate results into clear business narratives.• Perform sensitivity, attribution, and assumption analysis to support balance sheet and interest rate risk management.
* Validate the accuracy, reasonableness, and consistency of data, assumptions, models, and outputs; maintain strong data quality and controls.
* Deliver recurring analyses accurately and in compliance with treasury risk management, regulatory, model governance, and audit requirements. Enhance forecasting, valuation, and analytics capabilities by documenting business requirements, conducting analytical testing, strengthening controls, and supporting new investment strategies.
* Improve processes through automation, Power BI, Python, AI, and other approved efficiency-enhancing solutions; provide recommendations to senior team members and management
* Act as Lead Consultant to finance, accounting and Business Line management on matters related to corporate treasury and related financial management
* Monitor and evaluate global market conditions, funding requirements, asset and liability management, liquidity risk management, capital management, financial performance management, capital, and related activities
* Provide overall advisory on treasury finance and risk strategies
* Ensure data quality and establish controlled processes
* Lead targeted projects including guiding other teammates
* Collaborate with Internal Audit, Corporate Risk Management and Model Governance teams as well as outside parties including regulatory agencies and accounting and consulting firms
* Make recommendations to more experienced group members and management
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
* Interact with internal customers
* Receive direction from leaders and exercise independent judgment while developing the knowledge to understand function, policies, procedures, and compliance requirements

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Treasury experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Experience analyzing, modeling, valuing, and forecasting fixed-income securities across multiple asset classes and scenarios.
* Strong analytical capabilities, business acumen, and attention to detail, with a consistent record of integrity and accuracy.
* Experience in Asset Liability Management, Interest Rate Risk, treasury analytics, or a comparable risk-management environment.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and exercise independent judgment in a complex, changing organization.
* Proven ability to build effective partnerships and collaborate across diverse stakeholder groups and organizational levels.
* Experience in process or business transformation, including controlled process design and implementation.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Excel and PowerPoint, with excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting, finance, economics, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education
* In-depth knowledge of fixed-income products, including mortgage-backed securities, structured products, municipal bonds, U.S. Treasury securities, and interest rate swaps.
* Experience with third-party fixed-income and risk platforms such as PolyPaths, QRM, ADCo, Bloomberg, or Calypso.
* Understanding of accounting, valuation, interest rate risk, stress testing, model governance, and the regulatory landscape for large financial institutions.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with familiarity in data science, databases, Power BI, and AI tools.
* Ability to investigate complex issues, distill findings into concise presentations, and recommend actionable solutions.
* Strong ownership mindset, with urgency, accountability, and the ability to drive outcomes with limited direction.
* Demonstrated adaptability, collaboration, and effectiveness in a matrixed team environment.
* Interest in learning and applying new analytics, automation, and AI capabilities within appropriate governance frameworks.

**Posting End Date:**

21 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------

This is a rare opportunity to shape the architectural backbone of a global pharmaceutical leader at a moment when data and AI are redefining how medicines reach patients. As Senior Manager, you'll lead the Data Lake Operations across Teva's entire data platform — setting the direction for Databricks and Azure, designing the foundations that make AI and machine learning production-ready at scale, and establishing the data governance standards that keep it all trustworthy. You won't be executing someone else's blueprint; you'll be drawing it, working across business and technology leadership to turn a sprawling data landscape into a coherent, well-governed platform that teams actually want to build on. For a leader who wants breadth, autonomy, and visible impact — where the systems you design ultimately support better health outcomes for millions of people.

* Translate business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories into secure and reliable technical solutions.

* Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality practices.
* Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with streaming and event-driven technologies, such as Kafka or Azure Event Hubs.

Gallagher Center of Excellence is seeking a Senior QA Engineer with 10–15 years of relevant experience to lead quality engineering for Gallagher Drive analytics products. **How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

* **QA Strategy and Governance:** Define the end-to-end quality strategy, operating model, risk-based test approach, entry and exit criteria, evidence standards, release gates, sign-off controls, SOPs, checklists, and regression governance across analytics products.

* **Data and ETL Quality Leadership:** Define source-to-target reconciliation controls and data-quality rules across source systems, ETL pipelines, Snowflake or equivalent warehouse layers, semantic models, and reporting outputs.
* **Automation Strategy and Architecture:** Define scalable automation architecture using Python, PyTest, Playwright, API frameworks, reusable libraries, test-data utilities, reporting, and CI/CD integration. Prioritize automation based on risk, business value, repeatability, effort, and maintainability.
* **Visual Regression and Baseline Governance:** Establish Playwright or comparable browser automation for Power BI navigation, screenshot capture, visual comparison, threshold management, approved baseline updates, and defect triage for unexpected changes.
* **Azure DevOps Traceability and Controls:** Establish requirements-to-test-to-defect traceability, evidence standards, dashboards, workflow controls, defect templates, and execution reporting in Azure DevOps or an approved comparable tool.
* **Defect Governance and Root Cause Analysis:** Lead defect triage, severity and priority alignment, defect-ageing reviews, root-cause analysis, corrective-action tracking, fix verification, and learning from escaped defects.

* **Stakeholder and Delivery Management:** Manage competing QA priorities across products, communicate trade-offs and resource constraints, escalate blockers early, and align testing investment with customer and business outcomes.

* 10–15 years of software quality assurance experience, including technical leadership for complex data, analytics, reporting, API, and application testing.
* Demonstrated experience defining QA strategy, governance, standards, entry and exit criteria, evidence expectations, release gates, and sign-off recommendations.
* Advanced SQL and data-validation capability covering reconciliation, profiling, joins, aggregations, transformation-rule validation, and investigation of data discrepancies.
* Strong Power BI quality-assurance experience covering DAX, semantic models, data, interactions, role-based access, refresh, performance, visual standards, and regression governance.
* Strong data and ETL testing experience with Snowflake, Azure Synapse, SQL Server, SSMS, ADF, or comparable cloud data platforms and pipeline technologies.
* Hands-on Python and PyTest experience, including reusable framework design, fixtures, utilities, assertions, reporting, and automation maintainability.
* Experience with Playwright or a comparable browser automation framework for UI and visual regression testing and baseline governance.
* Experience with API testing, CI/CD integration, source control, automated execution reporting, and controlled adoption of open-source packages.
* Advanced Azure DevOps experience for test management, requirements traceability, defect governance, dashboards, sprint visibility, and quality reporting.
* Experience leading defect triage, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, release-readiness reviews, and executive or leadership-level quality reporting.
* Ability to mentor QA engineers, influence without formal authority, lead cross-functional quality discussions, and create sustainable knowledge-transfer practices.
* Strong business acumen, strategic communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, analytical thinking, and evidence-based decision-making.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience establishing or scaling a QA Center of Excellence or shared quality-engineering capability.
* Experience with AI-assisted testing, specification-driven test generation, automated defect creation, or governed use of enterprise AI platforms.
* Performance testing experience using JMeter, k6, or comparable tools; accessibility testing knowledge is an advantage.
* Knowledge of data lineage, metadata, observability, data contracts, masking, access controls, and secure non-production environments.
* Experience measuring automation return, manual-effort reduction, defect leakage, coverage, cycle time, and release confidence.
* ISTQB Advanced/Test Manager, CSQE, Microsoft Power BI, Snowflake, Azure, Python, Agile/Scrum, Lean Six Sigma, or related certification or training.

Overview
  
  
DNEG is seeking a security professional to assess applications, cloud services, AI use
  
cases, and third-party tools before and during their use across the company. The role
  
combines practical security architecture reviews with hands-on evaluation of security
  
solutions. The successful candidate will document risks, recommend workable controls,
  
and support informed approval decisions.
  
  
Mandatory Requirements and Expectations
  
  

* Own defined security reviews independently and escalate material risks or

complex decisions to senior security stakeholders.
  

* Provide clear, evidence-based recommendations that account for security risk,

business use, and implementation effort.
  

* Work closely with engineering, cloud, product, and other internal teams to

understand designs and agree on practical actions.

the security approval process.
  

* Communicate findings constructively to both technical and non-technical

stakeholders.
  
Duties and Operational Responsibilities
  

* Review application and API designs for authentication, authorization, data

protection, secure integration, and common attack paths.
  

* Perform threat modelling for new systems and significant changes, and

recommend controls that can be implemented and verified.
  

* Assess cloud architectures and configurations, including identity, network

exposure, secrets, encryption, logging, and workload security.
  

* Review proposed AI applications and services for data exposure, access control,

unsafe outputs, prompt injection, and third-party dependencies.

posture, data flows, permissions, integrations, and relevant assurance evidence.
  

* Plan and run proof of concepts for application, cloud, and AI security tools using

agreed evaluation criteria; document effectiveness, integration needs, and
  
limitations.
  

* Prepare concise risk assessments and recommendations, including proposed

conditions or remediation needed before approval.
  

* Track findings with system and service owners, validate remediation evidence,

and identify unresolved risks for escalation.
  
  

* Contribute to security standards, review checklists, and reusable design

guidance to improve consistency across assessments.
  
  
Mandatory Job Requirements
  
  
A successful candidate should demonstrate the following experience and capabilities:
  

* Approximately five years of relevant experience in application security, cloud

security, security engineering, or security architecture.
  

* Experience reviewing application designs and applying secure development

practices, threat modelling, and risk-based remediation.
  

* Working knowledge of application and API security testing, including code,

dependency, and dynamic testing approaches.
  

* Hands-on understanding of security controls in at least one major cloud platform,

particularly identity, networking, data protection, and monitoring.
  

* Ability to evaluate unfamiliar technologies through proof of concepts, define

success criteria, and present a balanced recommendation.
  

* Experience assessing third-party products or services, including how they

access, process, store, and share company or client data.
  

* Working knowledge of security risks in AI-enabled applications and the controls

used to address them.
  

* Strong written communication and the ability to work with engineers and

stakeholders to resolve identified risks.
  
Desirable Experience
  

* Direct experience assessing generative AI applications, including retrieval-based

systems or applications that use external tools.
  

* Experience with security assurance reports, vendor questionnaires, and

recognized security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, or OWASP
  
guidance.
  

* Experience evaluating or operating application security, cloud security, or AI

security tooling.
  
  
Education
  
  

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity,

or equivalent practical experience is desirable.
  

* Relevant security or cloud certifications are desirable but are not a substitute for

demonstrated practical experience.

* Seamless Collaboration: Engineering teams, PSSOs, and external partners view you not as a compliance bottleneck, but as an enabler who embeds security cleanly into the delivery lifecycle.

description:
**Director, MXDR Product**

**Level**

Director

  

**Function**

Product Engineering & Development — MXDR (Managed Extended Detection & Response)

15–20 years, including 5+ years leading a security or infrastructure product at scale

**Role Summary**
================

The Director, MXDR Product owns the MXDR product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, delivery, and outcomes. This person sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, security operations, sales, and customer success, converting technical capability into a coherent product that customers trust and buy. They will partner closely with the Senior Architect (who continues to own technical architecture) while taking full ownership of product direction, delivery commitments, cross-functional alignment, and executive/customer communication.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Product Ownership & Strategy**
--------------------------------

* Own the MXDR product roadmap end-to-end — define priorities, sequence releases, and make explicit trade-off calls between customer asks, competitive pressure, and technical debt.
* Translate market and customer signal (win/loss reviews, analyst reports, competitive intelligence, compliance requirements like FedRAMP/SOC 2) into a defensible product strategy.
* Own the business case for major initiatives — cost, timeline, staffing, and expected outcome — before they go to engineering, closing the gap between "good architecture" and "fundable roadmap."

**Delivery Ownership**
----------------------

* Own delivery predictability: turn architecture and design work into resourced, sequenced, trackable delivery plans with realistic timelines.
* Run the cadence that keeps delivery visible — regular progress reviews, clear status reporting (RAG/roadmap-vs-actual), and early escalation of risk rather than late surprises.
* Partner with the Senior Architect and engineering leads to convert technical designs into shippable phases with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**
------------------------------------------

* Be the primary product point of contact for CTO, executive leadership, and key customers — comfortable presenting roadmap, risk, and trade-offs to non-technical and executive audiences.
* Manage the inevitable tension between sales commitments, customer requests, and engineering capacity — and be the one who says no, with a clear rationale, when needed.
* Build and maintain trust with cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, SOC/security operations, sales, marketing, customer success, compliance) so the product roadmap reflects real constraints from every side, not just engineering's.

**Ownership & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Take end-to-end accountability for product outcomes — not just what was designed or built, but what shipped, what customers adopted, and what moved the business forward.
* Proactively surface risk (technical, delivery, market, compliance) rather than waiting to be asked — and bring a recommended path forward, not just a problem.
* Own post-release outcomes: adoption, customer feedback, support burden, and whether the product delivered the value it was built for.

**Domain & Technical Fluency**
------------------------------

* Be fluent enough in MXDR/SOC concepts (detection engineering, threat hunting, SIEM/UEBA/ITDR, incident response workflows, MITRE ATT&CK) to have a credible technical conversation with architects, customers, and analysts — without needing to be the one designing the models.
* Understand the compliance and certification landscape relevant to security products (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, GDPR) well enough to factor it into roadmap decisions early, not as an afterthought.
* Expertise in building AI based SDLC using AI tools.

**AI/ML, LLM, and Innovation Strategy**

* **GenAI & LLM Integration:** Design the architectural blueprint for embedding Generative AI and LLMs (via commercial APIs like OpenAI/Anthropic or open-source models like Llama/Mistral) into our existing products to deliver next-generation customer value.
* **Machine Learning Pipelines:** Leverage the **Python** ecosystem to oversee the creation of scalable ML data pipelines, MLOps frameworks, and predictive modeling features that enhance our application's intelligent capabilities.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Architect advanced RAG systems combining **Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch as a vector database)** and SQL to enable high-performance, context-aware semantic search and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* **AI Security & Governance:** Establish enterprise-wide compliance, data privacy (preventing PII leakage into LLMs), and ethical guardrails for AI usage, ensuring alignment with emerging global AI regulations.
* **Internal AI Automation:** Lead initiatives to leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and automated testing tools to improve overall engineering team velocity and code quality.

**Executive Technology Strategy & Enterprise Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Long-Term Technical Vision**: Define and execute a 3-to-5-year technology roadmap that scales with the company’s business growth, shifting engineering from a reactive delivery unit to a proactive business driver.
* **Polyglot Stack Governance:** Establish modern architectural guardrails and engineering standards for our composite ecosystem—ensuring seamless, secure integration between enterprise Angular frontends, distributed Python services, and high-performance .NET Web APIs.
* **Enterprise Data & Search Strategy:** Architect the future state of our data layer; guide principal engineers in optimizing high-transaction SQL databases (replication, partitioning) alongside massive Elastic Stack (ELK) clusters utilized for real-time search, analytics, and observability.
* **R&D and Innovation Leadership**: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI/ML capabilities to determine their business viability, running targeted Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) to maintain market competitiveness.
* **Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity:** Own the design and regular testing of global Disaster Recovery (DR) and High Availability (HA) strategies to guarantee maximum business continuity and strict uptime SLA compliance.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Required**
------------

* 15–20 years total experience, with a meaningful portion in product development or product leadership roles for security, infrastructure, or SaaS platforms.
* 5+ years operating at Director level or equivalent scope — owning a product line's roadmap, delivery, and business outcomes, not just a feature area.
* Demonstrated track record of taking a product from architecture/vision to shipped, adopted reality — able to speak to specific products they've owned end-to-end.
* **Technical Breadth:** Previous hands-on architecture experience in enterprise Microsoft environments (.NET/C#) blended with open-source ecosystems (Python, Angular).
* Strong delivery discipline: experience running structured delivery cadences (roadmaps, sprint/release tracking, RAG reporting) and holding cross-functional teams to commitments.
* Excellent communicator — comfortable presenting to CTO/executive leadership and to customers, and able to translate deep technical detail into business language and back.
* Experience working alongside (not replacing) a strong technical architect — clear sense of where product ownership ends and architecture ownership begins, and how to partner rather than compete.
* Working knowledge of security operations concepts: detection & response, threat intelligence, SIEM/XDR/UEBA, identity security, or adjacent domains.
* Compliance & Governance Alignment: Ensure all engineering processes, data handling pipelines, and architectural patterns adhere strictly to industry certifications relevant to a scaling mid-size company (**SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA**, etc.).

**Preferred**
-------------

* Prior experience specifically in MXDR, MDR, SIEM, XDR, or broader security operations product lines.
* Experience navigating compliance-driven sales cycles (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and their impact on roadmap and architecture decisions.
